verdict.rationale: Llama ships open weights that users download themselves, through the official llama-models CLI or the meta-llama Hugging Face org. First-party docs also cover running the models on your own infrastructure: Linux, macOS, Windows desktops, llama.cpp, and ExecuTorch for edge and mobile. Community comments about local VRAM requirements confirm real-world self-hosting, and license criticism concerns openness labels rather than whether self-hosting works. Missing for 10: ungated access, since downloads require license acceptance and approval via a signed URL; and independent hands-on corroboration that the largest models are practical to self-host.
